t: Din ezeh debarim muttarim lishloach beyom tob
s: Din ezeh debarim muttarim lishloach beyom tob ubo v' seipim: muttar lishloach lachabero beyom tob derek reshut harabbim kol mine maakal umashqeh hareuyim lebo bayyom, apillu enan reuyim ella al yede maaseh sheyyaasu begupan, kegon behema vechayya vaop chayyim sheenan reuyim ad sheyyishchatem, mikkol maqom, kevan shemmuttar lishchot beyom tob — muttar gam ken lishloach lachabero, ap al pi shehu yodea shechabero lo yishchatem beyom tob, mikkol maqom, kevan sheillu haya rotzeh haya shochatan veokelan — muttar lishloach lo.

Veken muttar lishloach lo kol keli tashmish, veken begadim apillu enan tepurin adayin, lepi shehen reuyin lishshaen alehem. Vaapillu beged kilayim muttar lishloach im hu qasheh beinyan shemmuttar lesheb velishshaen alayv, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman sh"a ayyen sham.

Vaapillu dabar sheeno rauy lebo bayyom, im hu rauy lehanot mimmennu bechol beli sheyyitztarek laasot maaseh begupo, kegon tepillin vekayyotze bahem — muttar lishloach beyom tob apillu derek reshut harabbim. Veap al pi sheasur lehotzi shum dabar sheeno tzarik lo beyom tob veeno motzio ella letzorek hachol kemo shennitbaer besimman ttz"h, mikkol maqom, kevan shehu neheneh vesameach bemah shemmeshalleach doronot lachabero — hare zeh tzorek simchat yom tob.

Abal asur lishloach dabar sheap bechol eno rauy ad sheyyaasu bo maaseh (haasura laasot beyom tob), kegon mine tebua sheen derek lebashshelan shelemim ella tochanin otan veosin mehem pat (utechina asura beyom tob). Abal muttar lishloach mine qitniyyot shedderek lebashshelan shelemim belo techina, vahare hen reuyin apillu lebo bayyom. Veen tzarik lomar shemmuttar lishloach yenot ushemanim uselatot.

Vekol zeh keshemmeshalleach derek reshut harabbim, o derek karmelit shehu maqom sheasur letaltel bo beshabbat, vegam beyom tob shello letzorek yom tob kelal, abal keshemmeshalleach derek maqom shemmuttar letaltel bo beshabbat, kegon bechatzer achat o beir hamorebet — muttar lishloach kol dabar, apillu mine tebua vekayyotze bahem middebarim hammuttarim betiltul.

Kol dabar shemmuttar lishloach beyom tob — lo yeshallechennu beshura, dehaynu shelosha bene adam nosein min echad vehen holekin kullan keechad zeh achar zeh beshura achat, shello yaaseh kederek shehu oseh bechol mishshum zilzul yom tob. Lepikak apillu bemaqom shemmuttar letaltel bo beshabbat, kegon bechatzer o bemaboy hamorab, im rabbim metzuyin sham — asur mishshum zilzul yom tob, abal im kol echad nose min echad — muttar apillu birshut harabbim.
